verdict.rationale: Thoropass monitors automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. Marketing claims the platform is 'alerting you to compliance violations', and the Monitors page and dashboard flag violations and controls needing attention in the app. Nothing shows those alerts reaching Slack, email, or a ticketing tool, so the 'where I work' part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing alert delivery for monitor failures or drift, the context included in alerts (affected resource, remediation guidance), alert configuration/routing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
